Dark substantial structural foundation below y=1200 to bottom. Character feet will be y=1080, well INSIDE platform. Architectural objects stop behind y=980. All lighting belongs to cold long-abandoned forge, no active lava river. Match reference detail and stone palette, maintain high sharp detail across wide scene. Output requested 3200x1300.
floor_study_not_used_in_final_hall: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE SEAMLESS HORIZONTALLY TILEABLE environment asset for a side-scrolling dark dwarven RPG. Reference image shows Hall of Silence STYLE and materials. Asset is ONLY a platform floor strip, no hall/background/sky. Requested 2400x600 panoramic PNG. Fill full rectangular canvas edge-to-edge, opaque. The TOP 340px is the horizontal broad WALKABLE TOP PLANE of gray-black worn basalt flagstones, seen slightly from above with shallow side-scroller perspective. Flat straight back edge at y=0, flat straight front edge at y=340. Three staggered rows of broad irregular rectangular stones with exquisite stone texture, fine cracks and muted bronze reinforcement straps flush with walking surface. BOTTOM 260px is the VERTICAL FRONT FACE of the supporting foundation, charcoal basalt masonry and inset restrained bronze dwarven diamond panels, visibly darker than top. Front edge a thin beveled stone lip, horizontal across width. Platform front must be a perfectly straight continuous level line at 340px throughout. No steps, ramps, obstacles, railings, objects, people, writing, water or magical effects. Neutral cold overhead ambient illumination, subtle warm highlights matching reference, no local light pools. Crucially make left and right edges match seamlessly for horizontal tiling: equal brightness, exactly same row heights, stone and bronze pattern continuing at boundary. This is a reusable floor material strip, not a full room. No vanishing point, no diagonal receding corridor; orthographic facade composition. Rich crisp hand-painted 2.5D game detail like reference, not low-poly or flat cartoon. Entire upper plane needs enough depth for both feet of an idle character.
